|lore=Pirates, smugglers and Rebels operate from tiny camps which can be set up quickly and relocated at a moment's notice. A surprise visitor made Luke an unhappy camper.
|game_text=Use 2 Force to deploy on any exterior planet site where you have a Rebel or alien. You may deploy characters at this site, even without presence, regardless of location deployment restrictions.

|rulings=* This does ''not'' circumvent restrictions listed on an Objective (even if the Objective references limiting deployment at certain locations).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=%3C%3EEncampment</ref>
* This does ''not'' circumvent text on a card that says it only deploys if a certain Objective on table.
* This does ''not'' circumvent rules or text that certain cards cannot ''exist'' at certain locations (e.g. no starfighters at [[Tatooine: Cantina{{!}}Cantina]] or [[Endor: Dense Forest]]).
* This does ''not'' circumvent deployment restriction text that is entirely unrelated to locations (e.g. [[Master Kenobi]] or [[The Force Is Strong In My Family]]).
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of presence or Force icons.
* Allows cards to deploy to [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] or [[Ahch-To]].
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of their own game text saying they can only deploy to certain locations.
* Allows cards to deploy regardless of game text on other cards (except Objectives) saying certain cards may not deploy to certain locations.
